servers.title: Servers
servers.subtitle: The machines the manager reaches over SSH, and the container engines they have.

pendingKeys.title: Host keys awaiting confirmation
pendingKeys.body: Claude read these host keys. It can add a server only with a key you confirm here, so compare each fingerprint with the one the server prints first.
pendingKeys.confirmBody: Claude can then add this server with this key. Confirm only if the fingerprint matches the one the server prints.
pendingKeys.confirmed: Host key confirmed. Claude can add the server now.

empty.title: No servers yet
empty.body: Add a server, then the applications it runs.

check.title: Connection check
check.wait: A check can take up to a minute.
check.blocked: Every operation on this server is blocked until the host key is reviewed.

state.denied: Installed, but the SSH user may not use it
state.broken: Installed, but it did not answer

engines.timeout: The timeout command, to stop a command that runs out of time
engines.deniedHelp: The SSH user may not use the container engine, so the manager cannot reach the containers on this server. Add the user to the engine's group, such as docker, or run the containers with rootless Podman as that user, then check again.

hostKey.title: Host key
hostKey.body: Every connection checks that the server presents this key.
hostKey.compare: Run this command on the server. It prints the fingerprint to compare.

review.title: Review host key
review.unchanged: The server presents the pinned key. There is nothing to change.
review.changed: The server presents a different key. Pin it only if the fingerprints match.
review.passwordHint: Pinning a new key needs your password.

publicKey.title: Public key
publicKey.body: The manager signs in with this key. It belongs in {path} on the server.
publicKey.label: Public key

merge.notice: Another server here is the same machine: the same address, user and host key. Merge this one into it, and its applications move there.
merge.title: Merge servers
merge.prompt: The applications of {name} move to {into}, and {name} is removed. Enter your password to merge them.

delete.title: Delete server
delete.body: Removes this server from the manager. Remove its applications first.
delete.prompt: {name} is removed from the manager. Nothing on the server changes. Enter your password to delete it.

name.label: Name
name.hint: A name to tell this server apart.

username.label: Username
username.hint: The account to sign in to over SSH.

privateKey.label: Private key
privateKey.hint: Paste the whole key, with its BEGIN and END lines.

keyPassphrase.label: Key passphrase
keyPassphrase.hint: Only if the key has one.

form.secretSaved: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.

accountPassword.hint: Changing anything but the name needs your password.

wizard.title: Add a server
wizard.subtitle: A server is a machine the manager reaches over SSH. Its applications come next.

hostKey.intro: This is the key the server presents. Run the command below on the server itself and compare the fingerprint it prints.

signIn.generateHint: A new key pair is created. The private key stays here, encrypted.
signIn.instruction: Add this line to {path} on the server, then continue.

check.addKey: The server refused the new key. Add the public key to {path} on the server, then check again.
check.ok: The manager can sign in to this server.

done.next: Add the Django projects it runs, on the server itself or in containers.

errors.no_private_key: This server signs in with a password, so it has no key.
errors.host_key_decided: This host key was already confirmed or rejected.
errors.server_has_applications: This server still runs applications. Remove its applications first, or merge it into another server.
errors.servers_differ: Only two servers with the same address, user and host key are one machine.
